findings.description: Original review found a `presigned == null` check left over from the old MediaClient contract (which returned null on failure). com.pte.media.MediaService.presignGet always returns a non-null response or throws — the null branch was unreachable. Fixed during this review: removed the null check, kept the url()-blank guard.

notes: Self-reviewed inline (quality-reviewer sub-agent hit its session quota mid-review; ck:quality's inline path used instead per skill fallback rules). Verified against plan.md/phase-08-scoring.md Design Constraints and the module dependency graph (scoring ──> session/attempt/media, never reverse): (1) No outbox/ProcessedEvent/AnswerIngestConsumer/ScoringCommandConsumer ported; AttemptCompletionService dropped as confirmed dead code (its AttemptScored event had zero consumers anywhere in services/*, grep-verified against services/notification and services/reporting). (2) New public methods SessionService.verifyHostAccess and AttemptService.getSubmittedAnswersForSession return DTOs/void, not entities, both tenant-scoped. attempt.dto.response package-info.java carries @NamedInterface, ModuleStructureTest passes (3/3). (3) ScoringCommandController correctly placed in com.pte.scoring (not session) per dependency direction; verified call order is verifyHostAccess before requestScoring. (4) ScoringIngestService upsert is insert-only-if-absent, never overwrites an ingested/scored row; DataIntegrityViolationException catch matches source's own defense-in-depth reasoning. (5) ScoringAnswerRepository.findBySessionPublicIdAndTenantIdAndStatus adds a tenantId filter the source's equivalent query lacked — strictly tighter tenant isolation, not looser (Nguyên tắc #5 held). (6) MediaClient->MediaService swap: ScoringReviewService.withPresignedUrl's try/catch correctly handles the new throw-not-null contract; OpenAiCompatibleSpeechScoringClient had one leftover dead null-check, fixed inline (see NOTED-1). (7) RabbitMQ scope confirmed limited to the AI-vendor work queue only (RabbitMqConfig/AiScoringJob/AiScoringWorker/AiScoringDispatcher) — no cross-module sync usage found. Full suite 382/382 green after the fix, ModuleStructureTest passes, grep confirms zero stray references to dropped classes (OutboxWriter/ProcessedEvent/AttemptCompletionService/MediaClient) anywhere under com.pte.scoring.
